title: 第十七章 魔药初体验第十八章 意外的惊喜求追读
slug: 从巫师学徒到万界征服者
content_zh:
莫宁的脚步刚刚迈入804号寓所，左脚尚未落地。
导引环再次传来一阵熟悉的凉意，一连串信息如溪流般涌入脑海。
【权限提示：序列号7-118-256，莫宁。】
【鉴于你已经获得“达瓦的杂货单”，身份权限自动提升一级。你可以支付10黑塔点，开启专属安全储物柜。“宁神药膏”将直接送入柜中。】
莫宁微微一怔，随即凝神阅读下去。
【安全储物柜受学院巫灵的严格保护。未经你的授权，任何人无法打开你的储物柜，也无法查看柜内存储的任何物品。】
【学院内设有多个存储间。在任何一个存储间内，你都可以打开自己的安全储物柜，存入或取出其中的物品。】
莫宁迅速理解了这套机制。
所谓的“安全储物柜”，说白了就是一个独立的储物空间——可以远程存放，可以随时拿取，有权限保护，有巫灵监管。
这是一个非常实用的功能。
将来他肯定会得到一些危险的巫术道具，或许是有腐蚀性的药剂，或许是会自发辐射能量的材料，或许是某些不小心就会触发的不稳定物品。
如果放在寓所里，万一发生意外，比如爆炸了，那该怎么办？
而放在安全储物柜里，就没有这个顾虑了。
更何况储物柜还兼有“快递柜”的作用。
区区10黑塔点，换一个安全的私人空间。
太划算了。
他几乎没有犹豫，以意念发出指令：“确认开启。”
导引环迅速给予反馈：
【已扣除10黑塔点。当前余额：395点。】
【安全储物柜已开启。“宁神药膏”已送达，请查收！】

下一瞬。
“咔——”
一声轻响，从书桌左侧传来。
莫宁循声望去。
只见书桌左侧的墙面上，出现了一条非常细的裂缝，旁边还有一抹奇怪的阴影。
他快步走过去，试探着伸手触碰那抹阴影。
指尖触及的瞬间。
一系列变化发生了。
阴影瞬间消散，如同被阳光驱散的晨雾。
一个木制把手从阴影区域浮现出来，把手呈弧形，打磨得光滑圆润。
紧接着，一大块墙面区域，大约一米宽，两米高，悄然从灰白色变成了木质。
纹理细腻，色泽温润，与周围的石质墙壁形成鲜明对比。
这是一扇木门。
莫宁看得一脸惊讶。
他下意识摸了一下木门。
触手是木头的质感，带着一丝温凉，纹理清晰得可以一根根数过去。
无论怎么看，这都是真正的木门，而不是什么幻术或障眼法。
content_en:
Mourning had just stepped into Apartment No. 804, and his left foot had not yet touched the ground.
The familiar coolness came from the guidance ring again, and a series of information poured into his mind like a stream.
[Permission prompt: Serial number 7-118-256, Moning. 】
[Given that you have obtained "Dawa's Grocery List", your identity authority will be automatically upgraded to one level. You can pay 10 black tower points to open an exclusive safe locker. "Ningshen Ointment" will be sent directly to the cabinet. 】
Mo Ning was slightly startled, and then continued reading attentively.
[The safety lockers are strictly protected by the academy’s witch spirits. Without your authorization, no one can open your locker or view any items stored in it. 】
[There are multiple storage rooms in the college. In any storage room, you can open your own secure locker and store or remove items. 】
Mourning quickly understood the mechanism.
The so-called "safety locker", to put it bluntly, is an independent storage space - it can be stored remotely, can be accessed at any time, has permission protection, and is supervised by a wizard.
This is a very useful feature.
In the future, he will definitely get some dangerous witchcraft props, perhaps corrosive agents, perhaps materials that spontaneously radiate energy, or some unstable items that can be triggered accidentally.
If it is placed in an apartment, what should you do if an accident occurs, such as an explosion?
But if you put it in a safe locker, you don't have to worry about it.
What's more, the locker also doubles as a "express locker".
Just 10 black tower points, in exchange for a safe private space.
What a deal.
He barely hesitated and issued the command with his mind: "Confirm activation."
The guidance ring gives quick feedback:
[10 black tower points have been deducted. Current balance: 395 points. 】
[The safety locker has been opened. "Ningshen Ointment" has been delivered, please check it! 】
The next moment.
"Click——"
A soft sound came from the left side of the desk.
Mourning followed the sound.
I saw a very thin crack on the wall to the left of the desk, and a strange shadow next to it.
He walked over quickly and tentatively reached out to touch the shadow.
The moment your fingertips touch it.
A series of changes occurred.
The shadows dissipated instantly, like morning fog driven away by sunlight.
A wooden handle emerges from the shadowed area, the handle is curved and polished smooth and rounded.
Immediately afterwards, a large wall area, about one meter wide and two meters high, quietly changed from gray-white to wooden.
The fine texture and warm color contrast sharply with the surrounding stone walls.
This is a wooden door.
Mourning looked surprised.
He subconsciously touched the wooden door.
The tentacles have the texture of wood, with a hint of warmth, and the texture is so clear that you can count them one by one.
No matter how you look at it, this is a real wooden door, not some illusion or deception.
